Nigeria has the highest number of out of school children in the world at 18.3 million.

10.2 million children are not in school at the Primary School level, while 8.1 million are absent at the Junior Secondary School level.

66% of them are from North-West and North-East Nigeria.
Burkina Faso has introduced new lessons for history, geography and civic education programs in schools to tackle colonial influence.
South Africa's President Cyril Ramaphosa urges the nation to prepare for potential exclusion from USA's duty-free trade program due to diplomatic strains.
